charts.title: HD 50554 b: orbits around HD 50554
charts.description: The orbits of HD 50554's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 50554 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname XIAO_ET_AL__2023): P 1240 d
